notes: Agent-39 delivered a functional vision reader implementation in 92 seconds with good structure and TDD discipline (95% test coverage). Verification passed despite initial FLIP score of 0.45, confirming core correctness. However, initial implementation missed 6 spec requirements (ReadResult dataclass completeness, JSON snapshot persistence, checkbox tag classification, claude-sonnet-4-6 model, snippet classification via LLM) that required verification to identify and fix. Test suite was expanded from 5 to 9 tests to achieve full coverage. Strengths: clean interface design, functional features, efficient delivery, good adherence to TDD. Weaknesses: incomplete spec compliance initially, insufficient test coverage before verification. The final delivered product is verified correct and production-ready, supporting downstream tasks. Score reflects solid execution with appropriate quality gates, though initial implementation showed gaps that a more thorough pre-delivery spec review could have prevented.
